description: List a customer's entities with cursor pagination and optional filters. Autumn API: POST /v1/entities.list. Returns { list, next_cursor }.

customer_id.description: Restrict the response to entities owned by this customer id.

plans.description: Filter by plan: array of { id, versions? } objects.

processors.description: Filter by parent customer processor: stripe, revenuecat, vercel.

search.description: Search entities by id or name.

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a prior response's `next_cursor` (omit / empty for first page).

subscription_status.description: Filter by status: "active" or "scheduled". Defaults to both.

name: list_entities
title: List entities
